item.title: Edel reports a theft of about $300,000 in EDEL tokens, with the stolen tokens since sold or blocked
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 5:42 AM ET)
- **Edel reports a theft of about $300,000 in EDEL tokens, with the stolen tokens since sold or blocked** — Edel reported the theft on November 12 and said it was working with authorities and exchanges to investigate; in a follow-up that day it said all the stolen tokens had either been sold or blocked by exchanges and promised a detailed post-mortem, without giving a breakdown between the two outcomes, and the notices do not identify the affected wallets or establish that Canton's network or Edel's other products were compromised (CantonNews)
- **Canton 3.7.3 maintenance release fixes a sequencer resource leak and tightens party replication checks** — The November 12 release addresses a resource leak that could increase sequencer CPU and memory use over several days and tightens checks around party replication, the process of bringing a participant's contract data onto another node; operators should read the upgrade notes before applying it, as changes affect experimental traffic top-ups, replication rules and monitoring labels, and publication of the release does not mean every MainNet operator has upgraded (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin burns offset only about half of recent issuance, at 439.3 million burned against 798.9 million scheduled over 30 days** — A holder analysis summarised by CoinMarketCap puts the latest 30-day burn at 439.3 million CC against 798.9 million CC scheduled for issuance, and argues institutional usage must translate into fee-paying activity to improve the token's outlook; the author disclosed holding CC (CoinMarketCap)
- **Progmat's scale in Japan's security-token market underpins its tokenized government bond build on Canton** — Progmat, which signed a memorandum of understanding with Digital Asset announced November 10 to build tokenized Japanese government bonds, already handles 51 of Japan's 103 publicly disclosed security-token projects, about ¥290.6 billion of roughly ¥470.3 billion issued; four MUFG group entities will test bond-for-cash settlement and the full repo lifecycle in live testing this month, the first phase connects Progmat's issuance platform to Canton and to Japan's book-entry transfer register, and 24/7 programmable settlement remains a project target, not a finished product (Genfinity)

item.title: Canton Coin futures open interest eases to $38.42 million as liquidations stay almost entirely on the long side
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 5:12 AM ET)
- **Canton Coin futures open interest eases to $38.42 million as liquidations stay almost entirely on the long side** — Aggregated CC perpetual open interest stands at $38.42 million, down 2.19% over the past 24 hours, with futures volume of $17.66 million running at about 2.3 times spot volume of $7.52 million; tracked liquidations totalled $51.33K, of which $51.12K were longs and only $210 were shorts, and the open-interest-weighted funding rate sits at 0.0018%, below the 0.01% baseline (CoinGlass)
- **Tokenization is measured in movement, Digital Asset's Yuval Rooz tells The Capital Summit 2026 in Korea** — Rooz argued that asset velocity and real usage are the metrics that matter for onchain finance, contrasting them with stablecoin velocity today, which he said comes mostly from crypto trading; the remarks were published on November 14 as a Canton Network update from the summit (CantonNews)
- **FiveNorth recaps CIP-0129: MainNet is the whole Canton economy, with every synchronizer burning on one model** — The recap, published November 14 with co-authors from the proposal, says dedicated synchronizers need no licence and applications need no changes under the universal-burn model, with first users expected in the first quarter of 2027; the recap describes the approved framework, not a live launch (CantonNews)
- **No Canton Coin arbitrage route is worth taking this morning, with spot prices now 8.19% apart across exchanges** — A November 14, 09:33 UTC scan found no CC route in profit after taker fees without a caveat: CC was cheapest on MEXC at $0.078634 and dearest on Bitstamp at $0.085076 across 12 exchanges with a liquid spot market, the widest flagged spot pair is marked suspect, and the best futures route, long WhiteBIT perpetuals against short Hyperliquid perpetuals, pays only 0.68% after fees, about $6.79 on $1,000 at the best book prices (ArbitrageGap)

item.title: Circle Internet Group and Upflam are named in the latest MainNet validator allocation notice as the onboarding queue keeps widening
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 4:42 AM ET)
- **Circle Internet Group and Upflam are named in the latest MainNet validator allocation notice as the onboarding queue keeps widening** — The notice, published November 11 under the heading "Validator Allocations - November 9th", names Circle Internet Group and Upflam alongside AUM-Digik, HostDeFi Validator Collective and Noah HQ; an allocation gives an organisation a place in the MainNet onboarding process and does not by itself confirm a running node or a launch date for native USDC on Canton, and a separate approval notice names five more operators — Canborsa, Carbazena, GateKeeper, Initiativ and Talwex — whose uses range from trading and liquidity provision to institutional commodities and corporate-bond markets (CantonNews)
- **Canton's app reward switch is targeted for February 2027, tying Featured App rewards to measured network traffic** — Under CIP-0104, application rewards would link to actual network traffic rather than manually generated activity markers; the February 2027 target remains contingent on Tokenomics Committee approval, so activation is not yet confirmed (CoinMarketCap)
- **Canton's DeFi footprint edges down in locked value even as daily DEX volume rises above $20 million** — DefiLlama's November 14 snapshot puts Canton DeFi total value locked at $11.74 million, down from $11.96 million a day earlier, while 24-hour DEX volume rose to $20.04 million from $19.09 million, keeping on-chain DeFi small against the network's institutional settlement activity (DefiLlama)

item.title: OnePump launches on Canton with 52 markets listed on its launchpad
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 4:12 AM ET)
- **OnePump launches on Canton with 52 markets listed on its launchpad** — OneSwap's memecoin launchpad has moved beyond its waitlist into a working token market: creators launch tokens that trade early on a bonding curve in Canton Coin and graduate into a OneSwap liquidity pool once the required reserve is reached; its public dashboard on November 14 displayed 52 markets and one graduated listing, JOSE, which graduated with 250,000 CC bonded, and creators earn 0.5% of bonding-curve trades and 0.2% after graduation, paid in CC and claimable from 1 CC (CantonNews)
- **Canton Wallet is back online on a more secure validator, with a one-time passkey upgrade at sign-in** — Users are asked to approve the one-time security upgrade with their passkey the next time they sign in; their address and assets stay the same, no fees are charged and nothing is sent as part of the upgrade (CantonNews)
- **Canton processed more than 5.6 million private transactions in one week, staying above 800,000 a day** — Daily volumes held above 800,000 throughout the week and peaked at 888,000 on November 4, with each participating institution able to see only the transaction data it is entitled to see under Canton's privacy model; transaction counts vary by what a source includes, so weekly totals from different sources are not directly comparable (CC Tools)
- **Digital Asset's DA Registry Proof of Transfer API lets users verify a Canton transfer without exposing its details** — The API lets wallet and exchange users independently confirm whether a transfer of a privacy-enabled Canton asset succeeded, failed or is still pending, without exposing confidential transaction data; Bybit has already integrated it, and Digital Asset is urging other wallets and exchanges to follow (CC Space)

item.title: MEXC's Featured App status is recommended for a pause over Canton Coin locking requirements
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 7:42 PM ET)
- **MEXC's Featured App status is recommended for a pause over Canton Coin locking requirements** — The Tokenomics Committee has recommended pausing MEXC's Featured Application status because it does not meet the Canton Coin locking requirements introduced by CIP-0116, meaning the exchange's party stops earning featured-app rewards until it complies (CC Space)
- **Canton Foundation opens Community Research Grants for original research and educational content** — Content published between November 1 and November 30, 2026 may be considered for the first round, with up to 50,000 CC per month available beginning in November 2026 at the Foundation's discretion; full terms, including eligibility and screening, are expected on or before November 15, and no grant will be made before then (CoinStats)
- **Wells Fargo is awarded three MainNet validator allocations as institutional node uptake continues** — The Canton Foundation Tokenomics Working Group awarded the additional allocations to Wells Fargo alongside Visoty, Cartumi, Winsnip, Winnode and Otoclick, issued in line with current network capacity and health assessments (CC Space)
- **Canton 3.7.0 brings protocol version 37 with new party-hosting states and lower ordering latency** — Released October 29, the version adds v31 topology transactions that give each hosting participant a hosting state for PartyToParticipant mappings instead of the old onboarding flag, supports multiple synchronizers without a feature flag, cuts CantonBFT ordering latency and bounds protocol, topology and ACS commitment collections, with messages over a limit rejected (Canton Network Docs)

item.title: R13N Labs' Canton Reward Engine gets a fresh Dev Fund vote after the first vote closed without passing
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 7:12 PM ET)
- **R13N Labs' Canton Reward Engine gets a fresh Dev Fund vote after the first vote closed without passing** — The reopened vote is still on the existing request for up to 3,636,363.64 CC for software that would help Canton applications calculate and distribute rewards funded by campaign sponsors; the previous vote closed without passing after receiving no binding votes, which is different from committee members voting against it, and approval remains pending (CantonNews)
- **Memora sets out how it would check the SOL backing of SOLx before any tokens are minted on Canton** — Each SOLx is meant to be backed one-for-one by SOL held in reserve on Solana, and Memora says it is using RedStone CAPS to check that reserve on Canton before minting, with minting stopping if reserve data is unavailable or the figures do not match; the November 11 explanation describes a proposed safeguard, not a live bridge launch or independently verified reserves (CantonNews)
- **Canton Strategic Holdings pairs its validator and Super Validator operations with a locking-as-a-service offer built around Canton Coin** — The company, rebranded from Tharimmune in February 2026, runs validation and liveness services on Canton and offers locking-as-a-service that secures its own Canton Coin holdings for clients while legal ownership stays with them, anchoring a digital-asset treasury strategy centred on CC (TickerOn)
- **Canton Coin now trades on 26 cryptocurrency exchanges, including KuCoin and Kraken** — The exchange coverage gives CC spot access across 26 venues, a wider listing footprint than a purely institutional network token would suggest, while the coin remains well below the all-time high of $0.1941 it set on February 3, 2026 (CoinCodex)

item.title: No Canton Coin arbitrage route is worth taking tonight, with prices 4.29% apart across exchanges
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 6:42 PM ET)
- **No Canton Coin arbitrage route is worth taking tonight, with prices 4.29% apart across exchanges** — A November 13, 21:19 UTC scan across 26 exchanges found no CC route in profit after taker fees once transfer and price caveats are applied: CC was cheapest on MEXC at $0.082748 and dearest on Bitstamp at $0.0863 across 12 exchanges with a liquid spot market, the widest flagged spot pair (buy MEXC, sell LBank, +3.51% after fees) is marked suspect, and the best futures route, long WhiteBIT perpetuals against short Lighter perpetuals, pays only 0.76% after fees, about $7.60 on $1,000 at the best book prices; over seven days a spread in profit opened 3,629 times and usually closed within about 2 minutes 42 seconds (ArbitrageGap)
- **Splice 0.10.2 activation runs through a Super Validator vote, and its featured-app metadata vote type changes again in 0.11.0** — The Canton Network Docs release notes say Super Validators activate Splice 0.10.2, which upgrades Canton to 3.7.3, with a "Set Decentralized Synchronizer Operations (DSO) Rules Configuration" vote, and that the release adds an "Update Featured Application Metadata" vote request type for use with Splice 0.10.0 and later; the older pre-0.10.0 version of that vote type can only change the app composition weight and will be removed in Splice 0.11.0 (Canton Network Docs)
- **Canton Coin open interest eases to $38.21 million even as futures volume jumps about a fifth** — Aggregated CC perpetual open interest stands at $38.21 million, 444.96 million CC, down 2.54% over the past 24 hours and down 1.17% in the most recent hour, while futures volume rose 19.55% to $17.62 million; Bybit carries the largest futures book at $12.67 million, about 33% of the total, ahead of Binance at $10.91 million and Hyperliquid at $4.72 million, a shift from the long-leaning, rising-interest positioning recorded earlier today (Coinfuty)
- **Canton's Global Collateral Network timeline shows 24/7 repo built step by step, with Japanese government bonds next** — Canton's on-chain RWA and financing slipsheet traces the sequence from real-time weekend trades of on-chain U.S. Treasuries against a single stablecoin in 2025, through multi-stablecoin and collateral-reuse trades, December 2025 cross-border multi-asset, multi-currency repo using European government bonds against Treasuries, and January 2026 weekend repo including U.K. Gilts, to synchronized pairing and settlement of on-chain Treasuries and USDCx in June–July 2026; digital collateral management using Japanese Government Bonds is listed as coming soon, with the DTCC Tokenization Service providing tokenization, Tradeweb operating the financing application and LSEG's DiSH tokenized deposit platform leveraged for the cash side (Canton Network)

item.title: Ledger Enterprise brings hardware-enforced threshold self-custody to Canton, targeting the single-validator risk in its wallet design
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 4:42 PM ET)
- **Ledger Enterprise brings hardware-enforced threshold self-custody to Canton, targeting the single-validator risk in its wallet design** — A Canton party is usually hosted by a single validator whose operator controls the node software and could in principle change local parameters to bypass standard controls; Ledger instead separates control of the asset from any one operator with a multi-validator setup that requires at least two validators to confirm a transaction, enforces the same threshold again at the signer level inside its HSMs and personal security devices so a compromised operator cannot lower it at the validator, and requires external parties to sign submitted transactions, with client keys held in FIPS 140-2 Level 3 certified hardware (Ledger Enterprise)
- **Zenith's EVM testnet for Canton is publicly live, letting Ethereum developers deploy unmodified Solidity against Canton rails** — The public testnet runs under chain ID 936485 with a faucet, public RPC and explorer, and its external_call primitive lets a Daml contract invoke a Solidity contract inside the same transaction so a Canton-native leg and an EVM leg settle together or not at all; the first milestone is complete, the second targets a demonstrated composability run on mainnet, and support for a Solana virtual machine execution layer is planned next (Bitrue)
- **New Canton–XRP comparison puts Canton Coin's supply growth at about 8.6% this year, ahead of XRP's circulating expansion** — On CoinMarketCap figures, CC supply grew about 8.55% from 36.82 billion at the end of 2025 to 39.97 billion by late October, while circulating XRP grew 4.4% over the same span and XRP's total supply fell by about 158,000 coins as transaction fees are destroyed; the comparison notes CC carries no maximum supply on the major trackers because it is minted as network rewards, whereas XRP was created at inception (Phemex)
- **Ledger Wallet's Canton support runs on a two-validator co-validation model operated with Kiln** — Ledger operates one validator and Kiln operates the second to Ledger's requirements on key generation, custody, recovery and contractual exit; both validators host the same wallets and both must confirm a transaction before the network accepts the resulting state, while balance reads can fail over between them, and Kiln exports the validator database daily to secure storage controlled by Ledger so Ledger holds an independent copy of the state its wallets rely on (Kiln)

item.title: Fairmint and Blockworks win approval for a shared 2.4 million CC Canton asset-data feed
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 3:12 PM ET)
- **Fairmint and Blockworks win approval for a shared 2.4 million CC Canton asset-data feed** — The Development Fund committee vote posted on November 13 approves one shared proposal, not separate allocations: 1 million CC funds the specification, publishing and checking tools and Fairmint's private-company equity feed, which Blockworks must fetch and validate, and 1.4 million CC funds a second publisher in a second asset class, Blockworks using both feeds in production and a 12-month maintenance commitment; daily snapshots are anchored to a record on Canton so corrections create a new declaration rather than replacing the old one, the two launch feeds publish aggregates only without individual positions or holder identifiers, delivery runs four months, and the vote does not itself mean the feeds are live or the grant has been paid (CantonNews)
- **Progmat's tokenized Japanese government bond working group now counts more than 68 institutions** — The Tokenized Government Bonds and On-Chain Repo group inside Progmat's Digital Asset Co-Creation Consortium, whose members include MUFG Bank, Mizuho Bank, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, State Street Trust and Banking, SBI Securities and Japan Exchange Group's Market Innovation & Research arm, keeps the underlying bonds in the Bank of Japan's book-entry transfer ledger with a designated custodian so the tokens stay tied to Japan's official register; its stated aim is same-day T+0 repo settlement against the traditional next-business-day T+1, and those settlement capabilities remain project goals being tested in the November sandbox phase, not completed features (CryptoPulseDaily)
- **Governance locks bring Super Validator and Featured App locking requirements on-chain from Splice 0.10.0** — CIP-0127 is the functional specification enforcing CIP-0105, which requires Super Validators to lock a share of their lifetime rewards to keep their weight, and CIP-0116, which requires each Featured App provider to lock a minimum amount of CC to gain and keep featured status; every lock must hold at least 10,000 CC, Super Validator locks release over 365.25 days and Featured App locks over 60 days, and the first increments shipping in Splice 0.10.0 run in a compatibility mode built on CIP-0056 two-step transfers to a master on-chain lock manager (Canton Network Docs)

item.title: Canton security advisory warns validators that attackers are targeting operators' internal networks
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 2:12 PM ET)
- **Canton security advisory warns validators that attackers are targeting operators' internal networks** — The October 26 advisory says Canton and Splice have released updated Docker images patching the eMudhra and node.js remote-code-execution vulnerabilities, and urges operators to patch all production components including Splice 0.9.4 and Wallet Gateway 1.13.0, keep root namespace keys offline or in a KMS/HSM, hold large balances only with external keys using Splice sweep automation, and, if compromise is suspected, turn the validator off and contact the Foundation; KMS conversion runbooks are in preparation (Canton Network Forum)
- **PostgreSQL 14 reached end of life on November 12, so Splice nodes must migrate their databases** — The Canton docs say the splice-postgres Helm chart is deprecated and unsupported after that date, so Kubernetes nodes must move to a PostgreSQL instance provisioned outside the Splice charts, with a managed service such as Amazon RDS, Google Cloud SQL or Azure Database recommended, while Docker Compose nodes must move to a newer major version by dump and restore with planned downtime, since bumping the image tag alone will not start on an older data directory (Canton Network Docs)
- **Production deployments show the integration work behind Canton tokenization, from repo to stablecoin clearing** — IntellectEU's account notes EquiLend's 1Source securities-finance platform built on Canton went live in October 2025 with BNY and National Bank of Canada among the first counterparties, Société Générale's first U.S. digital bond issuance ran on Canton, and the Ubyx Clearing Platform is bringing stablecoin clearing to Canton with Paxos, Ripple and Monerium among its issuers and Barclays as a strategic equity partner (IntellectEU)
- **WalletConnect adds Canton support, connecting its wallet network to Canton applications** — Any WalletConnect-enabled wallet can now connect to a supported Canton application, developers integrate once to reach that wallet ecosystem, and WalletConnect says the link opens its millions of users to Canton stablecoins, tokenized deposits, onchain securities and privacy-enabled DeFi, with private keys never exposed and sessions end-to-end encrypted (WalletConnect)

item.title: Canton draft would let Super Validators delegate their governance votes to a separate identity
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 1:42 PM ET)
- **Canton draft would let Super Validators delegate their governance votes to a separate identity** — A draft specification submitted on November 11 by Digital Asset's Raymond Roestenburg, not yet assigned a CIP number, would let a Super Validator operator appoint a separate Canton party to submit its votes through a dedicated voting app and a CIP-0103 wallet, without sharing the operator identity that runs the node; operator and delegate share the node's one vote, the latest vote counts, the two-thirds threshold is unchanged, and the operator can change or revoke the delegate and still vote itself; the work follows a 1 million CC grant funding the governance app, and activation would still need a Super Validator vote on updated software (CantonNews)
- **Fairmint wins approval for a 3.5 million CC Privy toolkit for Canton apps** — The Development Fund proposal passed on November 10 and funds an open-source SDK so applications that already use Privy for login and built-in wallets can sign Canton transactions without building the connection themselves; 900,000 CC covers a public release, documentation and a DevNet demonstration, 600,000 CC a signing component for Canton's Wallet Gateway, and up to 2 million CC — about 57% of the total — is tied to independent MainNet adoption, at 600,000 CC per verified integrator up to three, plus the start of maintenance; the first milestone is estimated at two months after approval (CantonNews)
- **Cashen opens institutional onboarding for cashBTC, a trust-held Bitcoin token built for Canton** — cashBTC is minted when Bitcoin arrives in the reserve and burned before it leaves, keeping one-for-one backing; the reserve Bitcoin is held by a licensed trustee with custody at BitGo Bank & Trust in segregated cold storage, only vetted, onboarded institutions can mint and redeem, and any Canton user can hold, transfer and trade the token and use it for settlement, trading and collateral, with reserve addresses, circulating supply and backing status published on a transparency dashboard (Cashen)

item.title: Canton's governance guide sets out how every network change passes the CIP process, with more than 117 proposals approved to date
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 9:42 AM ET)
- **Canton's governance guide sets out how every network change passes the CIP process, with more than 117 proposals approved to date** — Anyone can author a Canton Improvement Proposal; a proposal needs sponsorship from two Super Validators to reach a vote, approval requires a two-thirds supermajority across the 55 Super Validators in a 10-day window with no single entity holding veto power, and a CIP reaches Final status only after two-thirds of Super Validators implement it on-chain through DevNet, TestNet and then MainNet (CantonNews)
- **Canton scores 80 out of 100 for institutional adoption in a new comparison, ranking fourth of 27 tracked cryptocurrencies** — TokenSonar's November 13 comparison puts Canton ahead of Quant at 62 out of 100, citing its bank-infrastructure profile and 10 tracked institutional signals including Goldman Sachs, BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, DTCC and JPMorgan Chase; the scores update twice daily from regulatory filings, named bank deployments, ETF flows and on-chain real-world-asset data rather than price action, and the comparison rates its own data confidence for Canton as medium (TokenSonar)
- **Splice 0.10.2 release notes upgrade Canton to 3.7.3 and remove the last CometBFT support from the Super Validator app** — The release drops the remaining CometBFT endpoints, metrics and debug tab after the CantonBFT migration, and its Scan app now exposes separate featured-asset reward fields under CIP-104 v1.1, with the notes warning explorers that reading only the older app-activity fields will under-report total app rewards minted (Canton Network Docs)
- **Alea Research counts $157.5 million in Canton transaction fees in the third quarter, ahead of Tron, Solana and Ethereum combined** — The analysis, compiled from Alea Research, says Canton led those networks on fee capture in every quarter of 2026 and that current public-market traffic burns already offset about 69% of new CC issuance, up from 11% a year ago; the figures are a research model of network fee capture, not audited network revenue (KuCoin)

item.title: Canton's network now spans more than 830 firms, with the DTCC Tokenization Service able to connect to more than 150 production applications
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 8:42 AM ET)
- **Canton's network now spans more than 830 firms, with the DTCC Tokenization Service able to connect to more than 150 production applications** — Canton's November 12 account of the rollout put the service's initial pool at more than $30 trillion in high-quality liquid assets; the figures describe the network and service the tokenization platform can reach, not Canton Coin demand or token revenue, and the service itself launched on October 28 with Canton and DTCC's private Besu network as its first integrations (ad-hoc-news)
- **SBI and Cambodia's central bank plan a Canton trial for tokenized government bonds** — SBI Holdings and the National Bank of Cambodia signed a memorandum of understanding on November 13 for a proof of concept tokenizing Cambodian government bonds, with Canton as the planned network and interim results and a demonstration due at the Black Swan Summit in Phnom Penh on November 15–16; the central bank will register and manage bondholder information, SBI Digital Practice will build and operate the trial environment, and the stated goal is access to government bonds in smaller amounts through local financial institutions, with service details and timing still to be decided (CantonNews)
- **SBI and the National Bank of Cambodia also agree a Japan–Cambodia remittance trial using the JPYSC yen stablecoin** — The separate November 13 memorandum covers a proof of concept for remittance settlement between financial institutions using JPYSC, giving the SBI–central bank relationship a payments strand alongside the bond tokenization work; no launch date or service terms were announced for the remittance trial (CantonNews)
- **Developers flag that a silent signatory can block settlement of committed Canton Coin allocations until the deadline** — A November 12 Canton Network Forum discussion set out how a committed allocation on Token Standard V2 still archives or creates contracts the owner signs, so an owner whose node stays silent can stall settlement even though the allocation cannot be withdrawn; a respondent confirmed the underlying observer package-vetting dependency is a known problem expected to be removed in future, and recommended app authors defend with economic incentives that quickly exclude misbehaving users, whose own Canton Coin stays locked (Canton Network Forum)

item.title: Progmat and Digital Asset move tokenized Japanese government bonds into Phase Two live validation on Canton
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 8:12 AM ET)
- **Progmat and Digital Asset move tokenized Japanese government bonds into Phase Two live validation on Canton** — Phase Two, launched in November under the Digital Asset Co-Creation Alliance working group, will test issuing tokenized Japanese government bonds (tJGB), tokenized deposits and stablecoins in the Canton production environment, validate repurchase operations and gradually connect with major collateral platforms in Japan and abroad; the bonds keep the legal status of ordinary book-entry bonds and target 24/7 programmable settlement, with those settlement features still project goals being tested rather than finished products (KuCoin)
- **Review clarifies Canton's $370.5 billion in represented assets is all Broadridge repo recordkeeping, with no distributed tokens** — RWA.xyz data as of November 12 counts $370.5 billion of represented real-world assets on Canton, 88.6% of all represented value it tracks, all in Broadridge's Distributed Ledger Repo, while showing $0 distributed to investor wallets, 0 holders and $0 of transfers in the last 30 days; Broadridge itself reports DLR processed an average of $345 billion a day in repo transactions in October, $7.6 trillion for the month (Daniil Kozin)
- **Rome Protocol's Ostia EVM testnet has produced more than 53,600 blocks settling on Canton DevNet** — Ostia, deployed on November 12, brings Ethereum-compatible apps to Canton and lets developers test Canton Coin transfers as an ERC-20 token, with each block paired with a zero-knowledge proof; the release remains unaudited, is run by Rome alone and may be reset (CoinMarketCap)
- **Nomura Group and BOOSTRY approved for one shared Canton Super Validator arrangement under CIP-0130** — The November 10 vote passed with 11 in favour and two non-votes, giving the pair a single participation framework to earn up to 10 reward weight in total through verified milestones, with rewards subject to escrow and governance review before release; the approval does not by itself mean either firm is already operating a separate Super Validator node (CantonNews)

item.title: Canton Foundation welcomes six new members in November 2026, spanning liquidity, infrastructure and tokenized assets
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 5:12 AM ET)
- **Canton Foundation welcomes six new members in November 2026, spanning liquidity, infrastructure and tokenized assets** — Granite River Trading, Altus (formerly B-Harvest), Doppler Finance, Diviko AG, otcDigital Inc and Grofty Labs have joined the Foundation, bringing expertise in market making and OTC execution, blockchain infrastructure and validator operations, vault infrastructure starting with Canton Coin, self-custody wallets built for Canton, a full-lifecycle marketplace for tokenized securities and real-world assets, and a non-custodial wallet and DEX gateway (Canton Foundation)
- **Tritemius expands its iOS wallet through TestFlight as The Hub reports 1,000 members on Canton** — The Tritemius update adds support for cETH, HANDL and Edel's tokenized stock and index products, plus two ways to use Bitcoin's Lightning Network — a one-click option without running a node and a personal-node option — with Lightning remaining a separate wallet capability that does not settle on Canton and availability limited to TestFlight rather than a general App Store release; The Hub, which combines creator content, live rooms and tradable community tickets on Canton, separately reported reaching 1,000 members (CantonNews)
- **Morgan Stanley tokenizes U.S. equities and Treasurys through DTCC's Tokenization Service, one of the first banks to do so** — Announced on November 4 by head of digital-assets strategy Amy Oldenburg, the completions use a service built with input from more than 150 firms and signed by 20 participants at launch, which locks the underlying position at DTC, mints a tokenized representation on Canton or DTCC's private Besu network and mirrors transfers back to DTC records; Morgan Stanley now targets supporting tokenized equities on its alternative trading system in Q1 2027, slipped from an earlier H2 2026 target (Blockchain Posts)

item.title: Noves seeks 5.25 million CC to turn Canton activity into accounting records
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 4:42 AM ET)
- **Noves seeks 5.25 million CC to turn Canton activity into accounting records** — The November 11 Development Fund request, replacing an earlier 3.5 million CC proposal and not yet approved, would build an open-source subledger that turns authorised Canton transaction data into accounting records finance teams can reconcile, approve, close and export to their main books; 1.8 million CC is for engineering and release, 2.45 million for verified adoption — four independent organisations completing a qualifying close first, then ten — and 1 million for twelve months of maintenance, with a full public release targeted eight weeks after grant approval (CantonNews)
- **Cauri wallet users now pay transfer fees in Canton Coin as the wallet stops covering network costs** — Cauri, developed by Lithium Digital, previously absorbed the traffic cost of transfers for its users and now passes it on at cost: fees are paid in CC whatever asset is sent, are based on the transaction data a transfer carries rather than its monetary value, and generally cost less between Cauri users, whose wallets share one validator, than to a wallet on another validator, which must also receive and confirm the transaction (CantonNews)
- **Consensys lines up Canton as the next network for its service linking banks' private ledgers** — Consensys unveiled Sovereign Network Interoperability on November 2, a product pitched to banks, custodians, asset managers and market infrastructures that lets institutions transact across separately run private ledgers without moving assets onto a bridge or a shared chain, using its Cross Ledger Interoperability Protocol; connections to Ethereum-compatible networks are already available with Canton next in line, and the announcement named no customers (Unchained)
- **OpenZeppelin's Canton Daml library and four reference designs clear the Dev Fund vote** — OpenZeppelin, the smart-contract security firm recently acquired by S&P Global, has had its open-source Daml contracts library and four reference application designs for Canton — a privacy-preserving DEX, a lending protocol, cross-chain stablecoin payments and one further design — approved by Digital Asset and passed by the Dev Fund committee, giving teams building financial apps on Canton vetted, reusable building blocks instead of starting from scratch (CC Space)

item.title: SEC staff digital-commodity view on Canton Coin returns to focus as markets weigh its limits
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 4:12 AM ET)
- **SEC staff digital-commodity view on Canton Coin returns to focus as markets weigh its limits** — Fresh November 13 coverage notes that staff in the SEC's Division of Corporation Finance viewed Canton Coin as a digital commodity under the facts presented by Digital Asset and would not recommend enforcement action over programmatic minting by Super Validators, Validators and application providers if the stated conditions are followed; the coverage stresses the limits — the response is a staff position rather than a Commission action, expresses no legal conclusion, and does not address secondary-market trading of CC (ad-hoc-news)
- **Canton Strategic CEO warns MEV could raise hidden costs for tokenized stock traders** — Mark Wendland said issuers and investors need protection against traders who gain priority over other transactions, arguing that payments to validators can leave other users with less favourable prices; he said Canton is designed to prohibit MEV in structure and practice, with no universal visibility of pending orders and validators unable to accept payments to change their place in the sequence, while a Helius report tracked 1.55 million sandwich transactions and $13.43 million in profit from one Solana program (WEEX)
- **ETP Foundry builds a tokenized-fund toolkit on Canton and seeks its first fund sponsors** — The toolkit lets a fund company launch and run a tokenized fund on Canton without building the plumbing itself: fund shares are a standard Canton token under CIP-56, market makers create and redeem shares in one atomic transaction with the basket or with cash, and the daily net asset value is calculated automatically and signed on the ledger by the fund's own parties; its Foundation-approved validator has run on DevNet since September 24 with test funds holding cBTC, cETH and Canton Coin, and it plans Canton Development Fund applications under RFP 11 and RFP 12 as open tooling, still seeking a Tech & Ops Champion, with its code not yet independently audited and everything still on DevNet (Canton Network Forum)
- **Open-source DEX routing SDK proposed for Canton so apps can route swaps across DEXs from one integration** — The proposed SDK takes two tokens and returns the best route with an unsigned execution plan, with no keys, no signing, no hosted backend and no fees; bridges, wallets and apps could use it as the last-mile swap after bridging without integrating each DEX separately, DEXs join by writing a small adapter and opening a pull request — Cantex and TradeCraft are first on the list — and the Canton DEX Aggregation SDK proposal in the Canton Development Fund is still looking for a champion (Canton Network Forum)

item.title: Saxon releases self-hosted KMS drivers so Canton validators can keep keys outside AWS and Google Cloud
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 3:42 AM ET)
- **Saxon releases self-hosted KMS drivers so Canton validators can keep keys outside AWS and Google Cloud** — The validator security guide tells operators to keep participant keys in a KMS or HSM, but the only supported options have been AWS KMS and Google Cloud KMS; Saxon has now released two Apache-2.0 drivers, for OpenBao / HashiCorp Vault Transit and for Scaleway Key Manager, both passing Digital Asset's KMS driver test suite and running a DevNet validator end to end, while a Dev Fund proposal under RFP 26 seeks a year of maintenance plus a PKCS#11 driver for hardware HSMs and still needs a Tech & Ops Champion (Canton Network Forum)
- **Obsidian Systems prepares a machine-checked semantics of Daml-LF 2 so Daml analysis tools can be tested against a public model** — No public, machine-checked semantics of Daml-LF 2 exists today, so a tool with a wrong model can report an unsafe package as safe; the RFP 22 proposal would build an executable semantics of Daml-LF 2.x and the Canton ledger model in Agda over 12 months, with proofs on Splice code covering authorization, Canton Coin issuance, the CIP-0098 reward cap and the CIP-0105 lock schedule, and is seeking a Tech & Ops Champion and a technical reviewer (Canton Network Forum)
- **Pinnaccle approved as a Featured App as the new Featured App rules take effect** — The Canton Foundation's Tokenomics Committee approved Pinnaccle for Featured App status, which still needs on-chain approval by the Super Validators; Featured App status boosts the Canton Coin rewards an application earns for the activity it drives on Canton, and the approval arrived alongside version 2.0b of the Featured App Guidance taking effect on November 5 (CC Space)
- **a16z crypto cleared to join Canton as a Super Validator** — Super Validators approved adding a16z crypto's Super Validator weight to the MPC-Holding-Inc node under CIP-0123, giving the venture firm the go-ahead to operate as a Super Validator on Canton; a separate listing records the approval at a maximum weight of 10, with the network processing the change that adds that weight to the node that runs it (CC Space)

item.title: CapConnect+ enters Canton Super Validator vote with a plan for corporate debt settlement
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 2:12 AM ET)
- **CapConnect+ enters Canton Super Validator vote with a plan for corporate debt settlement** — CIP-0131, sponsored by Tradeweb and endorsed by MPCH, would give CapConnect+ up to five reward weight units tied to milestones for settling commercial paper and its cash leg together on Canton through delivery-versus-payment; the first production target is at least $100 million in aggregate issuance settled on Canton within six months, building on a platform that has facilitated more than $46.11 billion in commercial-paper issuance since early 2025 on existing infrastructure (CantonNews)
- **Further Asset Management approved as a Canton Super Validator, the first with a dedicated Middle East presence** — Approved under CIP-0113, the Abu Dhabi-based firm moves from capital provider to network operator, running a Super Validator node linking the UAE ecosystem and holding governance rights over upgrades and protocol parameters, with a portfolio of custody, tokenisation, payment and trading companies already building on Canton (Further Asset Management)

item.description:

item.title: Canton Foundation backs RedStone pricing tool with 15.8 million Canton Coin
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 2:12 PM ET)
- **Canton Foundation backs RedStone pricing tool with 15.8 million Canton Coin** — The Foundation approved almost 15.8 million CC, worth about $1.55 million, to fund RedStone's open-source Canton Access and Privacy Standard (CAPS) tool, letting institutions value transactions from a shared reference price without revealing their agreed settlement amounts; initial pricing covers tokenized funds, private-market assets and structured products under the Apache 2.0 license (Cointelegraph)
- **Uber completes 24/7 treasury pilot on Canton with HSBC, Franklin Templeton, Tradeweb and Fireblocks** — Uber used HSBC Tokenized Deposits to buy Franklin Templeton tokenized money market fund shares on Tradeweb through delivery-versus-payment transactions on Canton via Fireblocks, and liquidated part of the holding over a weekend while continuing to earn yield throughout the investment lifecycle (HSBC)
- **Societe Generale accepts $10 million in tokenized Treasuries as collateral on Canton** — The bank's Prime Services & Clearing division accepted the DTCC-tokenized Treasuries as eligible collateral, reflecting them in its existing back-office and collateral systems, and intends to develop support for recurring collateral movements and explore onchain repo financing (Societe Generale)
- **Circle reports 379.9 million Canton Coin held at September 30** — Circle's quarterly filing shows 379,921,930 CC with a fair value of about $48.0 million at September 30, 2026, up in quantity from 367,760,063 CC held at December 31, 2025 (Circle Form 10-Q)

item.title: Nomura Group and BOOSTRY approved for Canton Super Validator participation under CIP-0130
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 1:42 PM ET)
- **Nomura Group and BOOSTRY approved for Canton Super Validator participation under CIP-0130** — The November 10 vote passed with 11 in favour and two non-votes, giving the pair one shared arrangement to earn up to 10 reward weight through verified milestones tied to regulated customer access, institutional settlement and collateral integration (CantonNews)
- **OpenZeppelin Daml library and four reference designs clear Canton Dev Fund vote** — The security firm's open-source Daml contracts library and reference designs for a privacy-preserving DEX, a lending protocol, cross-chain stablecoin payments and a fourth design were approved, giving Canton builders vetted, reusable building blocks (CC Space)
- **SEC staff view Canton Coin as a digital commodity in November 3 no-action letter** — Division of Corporation Finance staff said they would not recommend enforcement over programmatic minting of CC by Super Validators, Validators and app providers as described; the letter is a staff position only and does not address secondary-market trading (Unchained)
- **CIP-0129 universal burn timeline points to private synchronizers in Q1 2027** — The first phase would apply universal fee burning to private synchronizers, described as ambitious rather than a firm deadline, with volume-based pricing estimated for Q3 2027 (CoinMarketCap)

Network: CC $0.08859 | Market cap $3.55B (rank 26) | 24h volume $11.54M | Supply 40.03B CC; milestone: CIP-0130 adds a path to a new weight-10 Super Validator arrangement on the Global Synchronizer (CoinDesk for market data; CantonNews for the validator milestone)

item.title: Canton roadmap leads with tokenized stocks, then repo and derivatives
item.description:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 10:33 AM ET)
- **Canton roadmap leads with tokenized stocks, then repo and derivatives** — Digital Asset CEO Yuval Rooz set out the sequence in an X Space: tokenized equities first, following the first trades under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, then repo trading, derivatives and private assets (BSCN)
- **Progmat signs with Digital Asset to tokenize Japanese government bonds on Canton** — The MOU builds tokenized JGBs (tJGB) with live pilot testing this month by a working group of more than 68 institutions, including MUFG, targeting 24/7 on-chain repo settlement (Genfinity)
- **DTCC Tokenization Service is live on Canton, covering Treasuries, equities and ETFs** — The service launched October 28 with Morgan Stanley reported as an early user; DTCC also co-chairs Canton's governance alongside Euroclear (Cryptensive)
